([[Los Angeles, California]]) * AZ Compass Prep
([[Chandler, Arizona]]) | college = [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] (2020–2022) | draft_year = 2022 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 57 | draft_team = [[Portland Trail Blazers]] | career_start = 2022 | years1 = {{nbay|2022|start}}–{{nbay|2024|end}} | team1 = [[Portland Trail Blazers]] | years2 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2025]] | team2 = →[[Rip City Remix]] | years3 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team3 = [[Philadelphia 76ers]] | years4 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025–2026]] | team4 = →[[Delaware Blue Coats]] | highlights = * First-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] ([[2021–22 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|2022]]) * [[Pac-12]] All-Freshman Team (2021) }} '''Jabari Dominic Walker''' (born July 30, 2002) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-sign-jabari-walker-to-standard-nba-contract He is the son of [[Samaki Walker]] and brother of University of California basketball player Sakima Walker. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]]. He was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] as a sophomore with Colorado. He was drafted with the 57th pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]. ==Early life== Walker played basketball for [[Campbell Hall School]] in [[Los Angeles]], California, for three years.{{cite web|first=Gregg|last=Rosenberg|title=Rosenberg Q&A: Past and Present with Jabari Walker|url=https://arizonavarsity.rivals.com/news/rosenberg-q-a-past-and-present-with-jabari-walker|website=Rivals.com|date=May 3, 2020|access-date=May 26, 2021}} For his senior season, he transferred to AZ Compass Prep in [[Chandler, Arizona]].{{cite web|first=Adam|last=Chalifoux|title=Tale of the Tape: Jabari Walker|url=https://www.si.com/college/colorado/basketball/tale-of-tape-jabari-walker|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=April 7, 2020|access-date=May 26, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 13 points, 8 rebounds, and 1.5 blocks per game. Walker competed for Dream Vision on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] circuit.{{cite web|first=Justin|last=Guerrerio|title=Dream Vision AAU coach Clayton Williams breaks down CU target Jabari Walker|url=https://colorado.rivals.com/news/dream-vision-aau-coach-clayton-williams-breaks-down-cu-target-jabari-walker|website=Rivals.com|date=March 24, 2020|access-date=May 26, 2021}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] over offers from [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]] and [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's]].{{cite web|first=Pat|last=Rooney|title=CU Buffs basketball adds 2020 forward Jabari Walker|url=https://www.denverpost.com/2020/04/08/cu-basketball-adds-2020-forward-jabari-walker/|work=[[The Denver Post]]|date=April 8, 2020|access-date=May 26, 2021}} ==College career== On January 14, 2021, Walker recorded 23 points and 11 rebounds in an 89–60 win over [[2020–21 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]].{{cite web|first=Pat|last=Rooney|title=CU men's basketball notes: Freshman Jabari Walker growing up in a hurry for Buffs|url=https://www.buffzone.com/2021/01/14/cu-mens-basketball-notes-freshman-jabari-walker-growing-up-in-a-hurry-for-buffs/|website=BuffZone.com|date=January 24, 2021|access-date=May 26, 2021}} In February, he missed six games with a foot injury.{{cite web|first=Pat|last=Rooney|title=Jabari Walker embracing prep for bigger role with CU Buffs men's basketball|url=https://www.buffzone.com/2021/04/23/jabari-walker-embracing-prep-for-bigger-role-with-cu-buffs-mens-basketball/|website=BuffZone.com|date=April 23, 2021|access-date=May 26, 2021}} On March 20, 2021, Walker scored a freshman season-high 24 points, shooting 5-of-5 from three-point range, in a 96–73 victory over [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] at the first round of the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].{{cite web|first=Jake|last=Shapiro|title=Jabari Walker goes ballistic as Buffaloes beat Hoyas, advance in NCAA Tournament |url=https://247sports.com/college/colorado/Article/Colorado-Buffaloes-basketball-NCAA-Tournament-win-over-Georgetown-Hoyas-2021-162751904/|work=[[247Sports]]|date=March 20, 2021|access-date=May 26, 2021}} As a freshman, he averaged 7.6 points and 4.3 rebounds per game, earning [[Pac-12]] All-Freshman Team honors. On January 25, 2022, Walker tied a career high with 24 points in an 82–78 win over [[2021–22 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]].{{cite news|title=Colorado completes comeback in 82-78 win over Oregon|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401408541|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=January 25, 2022|access-date=May 3, 2022}} As a sophomore, he averaged 14.6 points and 9.4 rebounds per game and was named first-team [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]].{{cite press release|title=2021-22 Pac-12 Men's Basketball All-Conference honors and Annual Performance Awards, presented by Nextiva|url=https://pac-12.com/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-pac-12-mens-basketball-all-conference-honors-and-annual-performance.aspx|website=Pac-12.com|publisher=[[Pac-12 Conference]]|date=March 8, 2022|access-date=March 8, 2022}} On March 30, 2022, Walker declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility.{{cite web|first=Zach|last=Ritenour|title=Jabari Walker announces he will declare for the 2022 NBA Draft|url=https://coloradobuffaloeswire.usatoday.com/2022/03/30/jabari-walker-announces-declare-2022-nba-draft/|work=[[USA Today]]|date=March 30, 2022|access-date=April 16, 2022}} He later signed with an [[sports agent|agent]], forgoing his remaining eligibility.{{cite web|first=Pat|last=Rooney|title=Done deal: Jabari Walker reportedly 'all in' for NBA draft|url=https://www.dailycamera.com/2022/05/02/done-deal-jabari-walker-reportedly-all-in-for-nba-draft/|website=BuffZone.com|date=May 2, 2022|access-date=May 3, 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Portland Trail Blazers / Rip City Remix (2022–2025)=== Walker was selected with the 57th overall pick in the [[2022 NBA draft]] by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].{{cite web | last=Grossman | first=Aaron | title=Trail Blazers Select Jabari Walker With the 57th Pick of the 2022 NBA Draft | website=NBA | date=2022-06-24 | url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/trail-blazers-select-jabari-walker-57th-pick-2022-nba-draft?srsltid=AfmBOoqwntlv97S1U0d4Uz3TN_GQMYDiPme0qorPXsZzO8ErHh9zZT6o | access-date=2025-12-06}} He joined the Blazers' [[2022 NBA Summer League]] team. In his Summer League debut, Walker recorded eleven points and seven rebounds in an 81–78 loss to the [[2022–23 Detroit Pistons season|Detroit Pistons]].{{cite web|title=Portland Trail Blazers vs Detroit Pistons Jul 8, 2022 Box Scores|url=https://www.nba.com/game/por-vs-det-1522200002/box-score|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 14, 2022}} On July 13, 2022, Walker signed his rookie scale contract with the Trail Blazers.{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers Sign Jabari Walker|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-jabari-walker|website=NBA.com|date=July 13, 2022|access-date=October 29, 2023}} He made 56 appearances for the Trail Blazers during his rookie season, averaging 3.9 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 0.6 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jabari Walker 2022-23 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4432446/type/nba/year/2023|access-date=June 11, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} Walker made 72 appearances (including 23 starts) for Portland in the [[2023–24 NBA season]], recording averages of 8.9 points, 7.1 rebounds, and 1.0 assists (all career-high marks).{{Cite web|title=Jabari Walker 2023-24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4432446/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=June 11, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On February 2, 2025, Walker was [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] to the [[Rip City Remix]].{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Rip City Remix Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rip-City-Remix/67/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=February 3, 2025}} He played in 60 games (including one start) for the Trail Blazers during the [[2024–25 NBA season|2024–25 season]], averaging 5.2 points, 3.5 rebounds, and 0.6 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jabari Walker 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4432446/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=June 11, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Philadelphia 76ers (2025–present)=== On July 5, 2025, Walker signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] and [[Delaware Blue Coats]].{{cite web|title=PHILADELPHIA 76ERS SIGN JABARI WALKER TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-sign-jabari-walker-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=July 5, 2025|access-date=July 5, 2025}} On February 19, 2026, the 76ers signed Walker to a standard NBA contract.{{Cite web|title=Philadelphia 76ers Sign Jabari Walker To Standard NBA Contract|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/philadelphia-76ers-sign-jabari-walker-to-standard-nba-contract|access-date=March 31, 2026|website=gleague.nba.com|language=en}} He made 64 appearances (six starts) for Philadelphia in the [[2025–26 NBA season|2025–26 season]], recording averages of 4.3 points, 3.0 rebounds, and 0.5 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jabari Walker 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4432446/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=June 11, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}}
